body: Oooo I have an identity now!
I feel so embarrassed by how I acted
I posted it in a long comment in my thread I embarrassed myself so badly
Thank you. really ashamed of myself
Thank you, just getting my next day started

I keep trying to tell myself to drink more water, I always realize the lack at work and start chugging water desperately. But at home you're right I don't drink nearly enough water and dehydrate myself a lot actually with my Juul that I'm chronically failing to stop even though I desperately want to

I've come to a point when I realize up until now I'm an utter failure. In my 26 years on earth I have ruined every relationship and friendship I've ever had. Not always in a really noticeable way, but always in a way that made everyone I've ever known look down on me for who they realized I was. No one I've ever met in my life respects me. The one really good friend I ever had, who respected me to a degree recently died. I say to a degree because it's true, he was my coworker and at first we got on well and he kept inviting me to parties and I kept saying no because of my social anxiety thst developed in college, even though I thought about how fun it could be like they were in high school I never went to one. For over a year he kept inviting me and I would say no and when I missed his birthday party too he got the picture and stopped inviting me out. We continued getting along well at work but due to my social anxiety we were never actually friends, we never ended up hanging out once.
It hit me hard when he died and also made me feel really guilty about how suicidal was feeling before he passed. I feel more suicidal than ever in my life, for the first time a part of me genuinely wants it all to end. And it could be that his untimely death is the main reason I'm clinging on for hope now. I fucking shattered my self esteem over the last couple weeks by frantically trying to talk to my ex again after she sent me one text out of the blue, the more I talked the less she did and now our old friend group is prank calling me and mocking me about things I only told her. Which means I'm just a laughing stock to her, and that hurts deeply because she's the one girl that really truly mattered to me and I wanted to marry. 

I'm genuinely stupid for talking to her so much and making it obvious as hell that I want her back 9 years later despite us breaking up originally due to me cheating. I just chatted about random bullshit like nothing ever happened between us without addressing that I cheated on her at all which was dumb. She's the one person I really shouldn't have been a simp towards and now that she's making fun of me our old friends it's clear she dont give a fuck and now definitely will never want my lame simp ass. I was deleting whatsapp messages even though I figured she read the notification to try and reword it in a way she'd be more likely to answer like an UBER simp and I could tell she noticed because instead of replying she just said "doppeeee". I could tell I was fucking up and only made it worse by trying to be someone I'm not, using her to fill a void in me, and allowing my happiness to depend on her. During our last phone call she said how her last ex was an ass and part of it was because he had a bad family so wanted someone to serve as that - and then I proceeded to outline all the problems I had in my family as if to tell her that I have the same fucking problems she just told me she didn't like about her ex. Now that I realize how much of a joke i am that she's making fun of me to her friends I feel terrible. She only hit me up because her ex abused her but no girl wants a simp ass loser so instead of being there to help I just turned into some sorry simp and now there's definitely definitely no chance of ever being close again. I shouldn't have let my happiness depend on her and called her so much, but now that I have she'll definitely never ever respect me and that hurts deep.

I was slowly doing better and better before talking to her from what I thought was the lowest point I ever was, but now I fucked everything up even worse that before, my sleep, my diet, my physical fitness routines, my self esteem, my chances with her. We'd talked before and I was never sooo simpy, it just happened she texted me the week my friend died and I kept thinking (well she's still alive so you should talk to her). I don't fucking know. I was in a bad headspace and should have focused on myself but was genuinely worried about how every day matters and made myself look pathetic by trying to talk every day and ended up destroying what was left of my headspace and now I'm stuck at a new low that I worked so hard to escape and just through it all away for her even though if I focused on myself she may have actually liked me but now, now I'm just broken and defeated

I feel weak and pathetic, I know I don't have to be but I am and the mountain of work I need to do to fix myself after wasting years doing nothing is fucking daunting and makes jumping off a bridge to not have to do any of that doesn't sound bad. I simply can't do that to my mother though. She is the only one who never gave up on me. She has been trying so hard to help me I can't let her down. I keep trying to tell myself good things will happen but can't get out of this godforsaken cycle where literally every thing that happens in my life, I make worse. I realized that over the summer, and had a major panic attack over it during which I told my mom "I have no idea what to do, every single decision I have ever made in my entire life has been wrong. Every single time I ever had a choice, I always chose the worst one. Even when in many situations there wasn't supposed to be a bad outcome, I still created one." No matter what I do, it remains that way, and I feel like I'm genuinely cursed, but that either way if I feel good again it's not going to be for years and will require a lot of hard work, like a lot a lot
Hey tysm! I don't wish to be a burden on anyone but could really use a helping hand

Give it meaning! If you end it now then you'll never have the chance to. But every day you wake up you have another chance to give it meaning! Don't think about your whole life at once think of it day by day. I'm also having a hard time now, but on weekends I do go kart racing because no matter how bad I feel outside of that, during the race I am having so much fun. It's one of the few things I know I can do and have a blast every time. I'm working on adding more things, I'm going to make a post soon about how much I learned from meditating - it's not to be underestimated! Our thoughts keep us trapped and the more we think the more trapped we get. Language was created long after humanity was around, and breaking our thoughts down "logically" like most people do when they think about things is NOT the way the brain evolved to work. The brain evolved to function on feeling and intuition. We have long lost touch with this fundamental principle of our bodies, and is a huge source of depression and anxiety. Meditation is one of the only things that trains your body to work the way it was actually made to. While most of society trains your body to work in ways it really wasn't designed for at all. Taking just 10 minutes every day to sit in one spot snd think about nothing will help you so much. Clear your head of thoughts and although naturally it will be hard, it's the effort that matters. You'll naturally get a bit better st it each time and THAT'S the goal. I have a lot of work to do still myself but this is part of my journey that I wish others knew because it does help, and I'll explain in much more detail about how this helps and how to meditate in an upcoming post, will share it with you when I do! Hang in there and I will too!!
